projects.title: Xélle.ng
projects.description: I built XELLE end-to-end for a Nigerian high-end lifestyle brand everything from the database schema to the admin dashboard. The brief was simple: make it reliable enough that payment failures and overselling are never the client's problem. That shaped every technical decision on the project.

projects.title: Zuta ya
projects.description: ZúTa Ya started as a meat delivery brief and grew into something much larger. By the time it shipped, it was a unified platform handling a storefront, butchery services, a grill house menu, event bookings, subscriptions, and a full operations backend all in one codebase.

projects.title: Chatmate
projects.description: Student mental health services are stretched thin. This platform gives students a private, always available space to talk and knows exactly when the conversation needs a human instead.

work.description:
• Orchestrated containerized application deployments across enterprise Kubernetes environments using SUSE Rancher, supporting 20+ applications/projects and ensuring consistent release quality and platform stability across multiple environments
• Designed and implemented CI pipelines from the ground up for multiple development teams, standardizing build, test, and integration workflows and reducing manual release overhead
• Embedded automated static code analysis and security scanning into over a 100 CI pipelines, enabling continuous compliance checks and early vulnerability detection without manual intervention
• Diagnosed and resolved complex infrastructure and application failures by systematically analyzing logs across Kubernetes (SUSE Rancher) and Azure DevOps environments, reducing mean time to resolution by 30%
• Maintained and iteratively improved CI pipelines across a multi-project portfolio, implementing versioning controls, dependency updates, and performance optimizations to support evolving engineering requirements
• Architected and delivered end-to-end CD workflows for 20+ applications, enabling automated, reliable software releases and reducing deployment time from 2 hours+ to about 30 minutes
• Implemented API performance profiling within Azure DevOps environments, analyzing response times, resource utilization, and latency bottlenecks to identify performance regressions and optimize application responsiveness and reliability

• Engineered complex, state-driven application logic using modern frontend frameworks, delivering scalable and maintainable user-facing features across multiple production codebases
• Led a cross-functional development team through the full product lifecycle from ideation and technical scoping through to build, QA, and production release ensuring on time delivery and engineering quality
• Facilitated structured troubleshooting sessions with engineering team members to systematically identify and resolve blockers, reducing downtime and maintaining development velocity under pressure
• Integrated third-party and internal REST APIs into production applications, owning end-to-end implementation including authentication, error handling, data transformation, and reliability testing

• Partnered with local and international clients to scope, build, and ship tailored software solutions translating diverse business requirements into functional products that met each client's specific commercial objectives
• Delivered consistently within fully distributed, asynchronous team environments spanning multiple time zones, maintaining clear communication, accountability, and output quality without in-person oversight
• Architected and delivered production platforms across regulated and high-growth sectors including Fintech, Web3, E-commerce, and HR demonstrating rapid domain adaptability and the ability to navigate sector-specific constraints
• Collaborated within globally distributed engineering teams, actively integrating cross-cultural working practices and diverse technical perspectives to continuously improve personal approach to software design and delivery

• Engineered and deployed custom AI agents across customer service, community Q&A, and task automation use cases reducing manual workload and enabling scalable, intelligent interactions without human intervention
• Translated high-fidelity UI/UX prototypes into pixel-perfect, production-ready interfaces with strict design fidelity bridging the gap between design and engineering to eliminate costly revision cycles
• Architected and delivered full-stack solutions encompassing frontend development, backend services, and third-party API integration  owning the complete technical surface area from user interface to data layer
• Maintained a consistent record of on-time project delivery across a multi-client portfolio without compromising code quality or technical standards demonstrating reliable execution in deadline-driven environments
• Designed and applied advanced prompt engineering techniques and fine-tuning strategies to align large language model outputs with precise behavioral specifications, tone requirements, and domain-specific response patterns
